eudaemon.translation: n. 善良的精灵,守护神

eudaemonia.definition: n a contented state of being happy and healthy and prosperous
eudaemonia.translation: n. 幸福, 因理性而积极生活所带来的幸福

eudaemonic.translation: a. 幸福的, 幸福学的

eudaemonics.definition:
n. That part of moral philosophy which treats of
   happiness; the science of happiness; -- contrasted with aretaics.
eudaemonics.translation: n. 幸福学, 获得幸福的方法

eudaemonism.definition:
n. That system of ethics which defines and enforces moral
   obligation by its relation to happiness or personal well-being.
eudaemonism.translation: n. 幸福说, 快乐说

eudaemonist.definition: n. One who believes in eudemonism.
eudaemonist.translation: n. 快乐说；幸福说 (eudaemonism的变形)

eudaemonistic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to eudemonism.

eudaimonism.translation: n. 幸福说, 快乐说

eudemon.translation: n. 善良的精灵,守护神

eudemonia.translation: n. 幸福, 因理性而积极生活所带来的幸福

eudemonic.translation: a. 幸福的, 幸福学的

eudemonics.translation: n. 幸福学, 获得幸福之方法

eudemonism.definition: n an ethical system that evaluates actions by reference to personal well-being through a life based on reason
eudemonism.translation: n. 幸福说, 快乐说

eudemonist.translation: n. 幸福说；快乐说 (eudemonism的变形)

euderma.translation: [网络] 花尾蝠属；优肤霜；斑点蝠属

eudialyte.definition:
n. A mineral of a brownish red color and vitreous luster,
   consisting chiefly of the silicates of iron, zirconia, and lime.

eudiometer.definition: n. measuring instrument consisting of a graduated glass tube for measuring volume changes in chemical reactions between gases
eudiometer.translation:
n. 测气管
[化] 量气管

eudiometric.translation: a. [化]量气管的,空气纯度(或含氧量)测定管的

eudiometrical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a eudiometer; as, eudiometrical
   experiments or results.
eudiometrical.translation: a. [化]量气管的,空气纯度(或含氧量)测定管的

eudiometry.definition:
n. The art or process of determining the constituents of a
   gaseous mixture by means of the eudiometer, or for ascertaining the
   purity of the air or the amount of oxygen in it.
eudiometry.translation:
n. 气体测定(法), 空气统一计划测定法
[化] 气体测定法

eudipleural.translation: a. 两部对应的,左右对称的

eudoxin.translation: 优多克辛(碘酚酞的铋盐)

eudyptes.translation: [网络] 角企鹅属；冠企鹅属
